summary.text: Ruwa Romman, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2022 to represent District 97 in Gwinnett County.

paragraphs.text: CNN (reported by Alaa Elassar, November 2022) said she was the first known Muslim woman elected to the Georgia House and the first Palestinian American elected to any office in the state, and described her as a 29-year-old community organizer.
According to the CNN report, Romman began working with the Georgia Muslim Voter Project in 2015 and helped establish the state chapter of the Council on American-Islamic Relations.

sources.title: Georgia candidate makes history as first known Muslim and Palestinian woman elected to state House (CNN, by Alaa Elassar; via ABC17 News)
